intuition.statement: A project-owned semantic proposal can make hypothesis content adaptive without transferring control authority.

hypothesis.statement: Binding a typed model proposal to the revision-reserved Discovery run will preserve deterministic decisions while replacing fixed hypothesis prose.
falsifiable_predictions: An accepted proposal should change intuition and hypothesis content while all selected actions remain SEARCH, FORM_INTUITION, and FORM_WORKING_HYPOTHESIS.
A rejected source or probe reference should create no Discovery state step.

alternative_explanations: The same benefit may come from richer deterministic templates rather than semantic generation.
output_payload.uncertainty: The offline fixture validates integration and authority boundaries, not open-ended scientific quality.
